context.schema:
generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client"
  output  = "../app/generated/prisma"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "sqlite"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

enum EntryDirection {
  DEBIT
  CREDIT
}

model Transfer {
  id String @id @default(cuid())
  reference String @unique
  status EntryDirection
  amountCents BigInt
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @default(now())
  audit_eventId Int
  auditEvents AuditEvent[]
  deletedAt DateTime?
}

model LedgerEntry {
  id String @id @default(cuid())
  amountCents BigInt
  direction EntryDirection
  memo String?
  bookedAt DateTime @default(now())
  deletedAt DateTime?
}

model AuditEvent {
  id String @id @default(cuid())
  action String
  payload Json?
  at DateTime @default(now())
  deletedAt DateTime?
}

model Tenant {
  id String @id @default(cuid())
  slug String @unique
  name String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @default(now())
  ledger_entryId Int
  entries LedgerEntry[]
  deletedAt DateTime?
}
